socket_events.note: Socket.IO on same HTTP server as Express

role_based_access.manager: View all orders change order status role in DB partially enforced
role_based_access.accountant: Finance screens role in DB RBAC not yet enforced
role_based_access.admin: Full access all CRUD delete products/expenses/incomes view audit logs
role_based_access.employee: Create edit products create orders record inventory movements
role_based_access.rbac_note: Only admin/employee fully enforced. Expand rbac.middleware.js for other roles.
role_based_access.warehouse: Inventory movements role in DB RBAC not yet enforced

postgresql_production.plan: Change prisma datasource to postgresql update DATABASE_URL to Railway or Supabase run prisma migrate deploy.

ai_sales_forecast.plan: Python FastAPI + Prophet microservice /api/ai/forecast endpoint Analytics tab shows prediction chart.

product_image_upload.status: Cloudinary configured server-side Flutter UI missing
product_image_upload.plan: Add image_picker to pubspec. AddEditProductScreen image picker. POST multipart/form-data to backend uploads to Cloudinary.

expanded_rbac.status: roles in DB middleware only enforces admin/employee
expanded_rbac.plan: Update backend/src/shared/middlewares/rbac.middleware.js to enforce manager/accountant/warehouse per route group.

barcode_scanning.plan: Create lib/shared/screens/barcode_scanner_screen.dart using MobileScannerController. Add scan button to CreateOrderScreen AppBar finds product by ID adds to cart. Add to _RecordMovementSheet auto-selects product.

push_notifications.plan: Firebase Cloud Messaging notify on order:created and when product hits low stock threshold.

web_admin_dashboard.plan: React/Next.js dashboard consuming same REST API.

refresh_tokens.plan: Backend POST /api/auth/refresh. Flutter store refreshToken add 401 Dio interceptor auto-refreshes.

offline_mode.plan: Wrap ProductService.getAll with Hive box serve from box if offline write to box on successful fetch.

known_issues_and_fixes.tunnel_url_expires: localhost.run URL changes every restart. Update ngrok case in api_endpoints.dart rebuild.
known_issues_and_fixes.Switch_activeColor_deprecated: Use activeThumbColor + activeTrackColor instead of activeColor on Switch.
known_issues_and_fixes.const_in_SliverAppBar: Remove inner const from Text inside const SliverAppBar.
known_issues_and_fixes.DropdownButtonFormField_value_deprecated: Use initialValue not value deprecated in Flutter 3.x.
known_issues_and_fixes.usb_unauthorized: Phone sleeps between builds loses authorization. Unlock phone accept Allow USB debugging Always allow popup.
known_issues_and_fixes.context_async_gap: Capture provider ref BEFORE await or Navigator.push. Check mounted before using context after async.
known_issues_and_fixes.port_3000_busy: EADDRINUSE: Stop-Process node PID in PowerShell.
